name: CoMind-plugins
description: ZTE-AICloud/Co-OmniSpec marketplace: ships the two Claude Code plugins (omni-dsdd and omni-reverse) that together cover Spec-Driven Development planning/implementation and code reverse engineering.

plugins.name: omni-dsdd
plugins.description: Spec-Driven Development pipeline: slash commands and shared scripts for constitution, specify, clarify, design, tasks, implement and archive. Owns the .omni-infra assets (config, memory, metamodel, templates).

plugins.name: omni-reverse
plugins.description: Code reverse engineering toolkit: turns existing code into SDD artefacts (logic architecture, interfaces, functions, entities, scenarios, requirements, rules). Depends on omni-dsdd for shared assets via scripts/resolve-dsdd-root.{sh,py,ps1}.
